verification_instructions.title: **· · ── 𓆩♡𓆪 INSTRUCTIONS 𓆩♡𓆪 ── · ·**
verification_instructions.description: You may verify through one of the methods instructed below, you may use a national ID, passport or driver's license as identification. Other methods won't be accepted.

fields.name: ▹ **IMAGE VERIFICATION**
fields.value:
You will need to take two pictures:

▹ Picture of your ID that clearly displays your DoB and your picture, the rest of your information may be blurred or crossed out.
▹ Selfie holding the ID showing your date of birth and picture and a piece of paper with the server's name, current date, and your discord username written on it.

fields.name: ▹ **VIDEO VERIFICATION**
fields.value: Alternatively you can request a member of the staff team to verify you in a non recorded videocall where you'll have to simply hold your ID and show it closer to the cam as required to read the date of birth.

verification_instructions.footer: All information/pictures provided for the verifiation process will be completely eliminated after the process.
